aggregation: one context-drug-dose unit, drug and context fixed effects, drug-cluster bootstrap
axis_name: Tahoe low-dose displacement on ST-HVG zero-shot STATE
confirmation_set: official ST-HVG-Tahoe zero-shot state_generalization_zeroshot_X_hvg eval_best tables, unread before freeze
deduplication: one official score per normalized context-drug-dose
direction: lower administered dose predicts lower STATE performance
discovery_confirmation_separation: A8 ST-SE few-shot was the directionally consistent discovery/rescue trigger; ST-HVG zero-shot scores were sealed
distance_metric: standardized negative base-10 log dose; larger is lower dose
error_spending_plan: this is the sole rescue of the directionally consistent A8 dose candidate; no further dose checkpoint tests if it fails
fixed_reference: equal-training-cell-line Tahoe pseudobulk LFC for the same drug-dose, scored against identical held-out response/significant genes without using held-out outcomes to predict
gene_set: official significant-real-DE genes used by the released de_spearman_lfc_sig metric
hypothesis_source: directionally consistent A8 dose result rescued once under the protocol on an unread representation/checkpoint
inclusion_exclusion: 199 drugs complete at all three doses across five official contexts; finite scores only; all missing rows reported
level_rule: fixed experimental doses 5.0, 0.5, and 0.05 uM without binning
mechanism_gate: if held-out nDE/cell support absorbs dose, attribute the driver to response magnitude or measurement floor and retain dose as the prospective experimental proxy
metric: de_spearman_lfc_sig; Fisher-z coefficient per SD negative-log dose
normalization: official signed-LFC Spearman transformed by Fisher z
power_plan: single rescue look with 10,000 drug-cluster bootstrap draws using all complete examples
prospective_features: administered concentration 5.0, 0.5, and 0.05 uM within each drug
reference_gate: classify a confirmed degradation as larger, comparable, or smaller than the fixed reference; do not reject shared degradation
sample_size_target: all available of 199 drug clusters and 2,985 planned units; minimum 150 drug clusters
success_criteria: confirm degradation only when the unadjusted negative-log-dose coefficient CI is below zero and the 0.05-minus-5.0 uM raw-score contrast is negative; adjusted analysis must remain negative
unit: held-out Tahoe cell line x drug x dose
